proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ H p hp hdvd hmin hH
  have hne : Nat.card G ≠ 1 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hdvd; exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp hdvd)
  have hfac : p = (Nat.card G).minFac :=
    le_antisymm (hmin _ (Nat.minFac_prime hne) (Nat.minFac_dvd _)) (Nat.minFac_le_of_dvd hp.two_le hdvd)
  exact Subgroup.normal_of_index_eq_minFac_card (hH.trans hfac)
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (H : Subgroup G) (p : ℕ), p.Prime → p ∣ Nat.card G → (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ Nat.card G → p ≤ q) → H.index = p → H.Normal
